visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with dark hair, wearing a white short-sleeved t-shirt, stands in a large walk-in closet with rows of garments. He enthusiastically holds a large black leather hoodie by its shoulders, turning it to display the smooth, reflective back surface and the attached hood. (2) He holds a black circular garment bag which features white printed text. He looks directly at the camera with a wide smile, then begins to unfasten the bag's closure while standing in front of a dark dresser. (3) He pulls out a black leather bomber-style jacket, showing the attached paper tags and pointing specifically to the shoulder seams. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the texture and sheen of the premium leather material. (4) The man puts the jacket on over his white t-shirt, posing with hands on hips and turning 360 degrees. The jacket features significant padding in the shoulders and a cropped waist, creating a distinct inverted-triangle silhouette. (5) A close-up shot focuses on the lower back of the jacket where the leather meets a wide, black ribbed elastic waistband. His hands manipulate the fabric to demonstrate the 'puffed' or 'stacked' aesthetic of the oversized leather cut. (6) He returns to a medium shot, giving a thumbs up and then picking up a fluffy white polar bear plush toy. He smiles warmly and pets the toy's head, standing next to a light-colored stool.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A friendly male voice speaks with high arousal and a professional yet enthusiastic tone, greeting the audience. A mid-tempo electronic pop BGM at approximately 105 BPM starts with a clean, rhythmic beat and soft synthesizer textures. (2) The narration continues with clear articulation, emphasizing the brand name with a slightly rising intonation. The BGM remains constant in the background, maintaining a cheerful and upbeat energetic vibe throughout the speech. (3) Audible rustling sounds of thick fabric and plastic occur as the garment bag is opened. The speaker's voice maintains a moderate conversational loudness with consistent pitch variability that suggests a high level of confidence. (4) A sharp, metallic zipping sound is heard, followed by more fabric rustling as the leather material is manipulated. The ambient noise floor is very low, characteristic of a quiet indoor recording environment or studio. (5) The speaker describes technical details of the clothing, his voice exhibiting a smiling quality. Short percussive hits in the BGM synchronize with the speech rhythm, while incidental rustling of the jacket's leather surfaces continues. (6) The vocal valence remains highly positive. A brief increase in speech rate occurs as he introduces a new item, followed by a soft 'Hi' and the sound of fabric rubbing as he pets the plushie.
